description: Shows the Kargom card with cargo prices for a parcel inside Türkiye: typical sizes for items like a suitcase, the prices of all carriers and the user’s saved recipients. Read-only: opening the card charges nothing and creates nothing; a shipment is only created if the user themselves presses the confirm button inside the card. Use it for price questions and when the user wants to send something. If the user already named an address-book recipient and a carrier and asked to send, use create_shipment directly instead. Pass whatever the user already said (item, desi or kg, recipient name, carrier or "cheapest"). When the user named both the recipient and the carrier (or the cheapest), the card asks only the size and then ships by itself. For a recipient who is not in the address book, use quote_shipment with the full address.

carrier.description: Carrier the user asked for (e.g. hepsijet), or "cheapest" when they said the cheapest / en uygun

desi.description: Desi if the user gave it

item.description: What is being sent, in the user’s words (e.g. "valiz", "evrak")

recipient.description: Recipient name, phone or city if the user said it

size.description: Item size if the user said it (e.g. cabin suitcase = small)

weight_kg.description: Weight in kg if the user gave it

name: start_shipment
title: Show Kargom prices card
